label: 172.Nashville_Warbler
summary: The Nashville Warbler (Setophaga warbler) is an avian species characterized by specialized plumage and foraging adaptations. It primarily inhabits temperate mixed forests, boreal woodlands, and scrub, where its diet consists primarily of caterpillars, flying insects, aphids, and spiders.
habitat: Temperate mixed forests, boreal woodlands, and scrub
diet: Caterpillars, flying insects, aphids, and spiders
